notes.title: Updates for January 1, 2025
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that the Steam client is now fully updated to match the main client! This update includes numerous enhancements and changes, such as:


 Bug Fixes: Improved stability and performance.
 New Events: Experience the excitement of Port City!
 Revamped Siege War: A fan-favorite event returns with new improvements.


Don’t miss out—join the action and play today!

notes.content:

XTREME SERVER
This server is a for fun server that is targetted to those who basically no longer have a lot of time to play. 

Features:

 High experience rate
 High KI rate
 Slates and Chestnuts have high fame rate
 A lot of premium items

 White Elder Dragonic Relic   -     Storage (Level 100-Up)   For rebirth only


REBIRTH SYSTEM
A new NPC (Pixie) will be added to Wrocklaw Map for the Rebirth System.

Requirements for Rebirth:

 Level 430.
 No equipped armors, weapon and accessories.

 
Fee for Rebirth: (first rebirth)

 10,000 fame.
 10,000 Shang-tu Arena score points. (points will be subtracted)

 
What will happen? Character will...

 Go back to level 10 (First rebirth).
 Get 0.5% of HP and MP.
 Sample: 5,000 for 1,000,000
 Get 10% of all stats.
 Sample: 1,000 for 9,999
 Be cleared of all learned skills.
 Obtain a White Elder Dragonic Pendant.

 
For every rebirth; the fee and the results will change.

 Fee increase +1,000 fame and points per rebirth. (max: 50,000)
 Sample: 15,000 on 5th rebirth.
 Level will be subtracted by -1 per rebirth but will stop subtracting at level 1. (min: 1)
 Sample: Lv 3 on 7th rebirth.
 Stats retained increases by +2% per rebirth but will stop at +30%. (max: 30%)
 Sample: 26% on 8th rebirth.
 Bonus HP and MP per rebirth increases by 300 but will stop at a total of +4,000. (max: 4,000)
 Sample: Total of +1,716,000 bonus HP and MP at level 430 on 13th rebirth.

notes.title: Full Disclosure of MIP party incident
notes.content:
Good day Khanatics,

As a background of the incident, see this discussion.

[code]On the 5th of April a GM (Game Moderator) was seen in Mist Iron Prison, allegedly in a group (party) with 5 other non-GM players.
[/code]

Alleged Party Members

 [GM]-TamahaganE (knight)
 THAILAND (knight)
 me0zzzzz (sorcerer)
 IS7 (knight)
 Sylar (assassin)
 Olive (micko)


 I was just checking the Ki rates as players were reporting it was too low. 

What was wrong with the way it was tested?

 Rates was not properly tested because of the level gap created between the non-GM characters vs the GM character.
 GM's should never party with non-GM characters unless it is necessary, such as when there is an event.
 When testing, GM's should never use GM characters because it is unbalanced and could give unreliable results. (should only test with configured normal characters that will be deleted afterwards)


Everything that follows is based on the investigation of the game logs.

 The party lasted for 112 seconds (about 2 minutes)
 About 20 monsters were killed 
 1 Lynch King was killed
 Only Ki Balls and Golds were looted for the duration of the party
 ...checking/additional_info


...INVESTIGATION ON-GOING (will be updated)

Resolution
A resolution is currently being internally debated, one of the leaned on option is to remove all ki, exp, items acquired within the party. 

Apologies
We are very sorry for our reckless judgement. We apologize to the whole Khan Steam community and to those who got involved, for it was not their fault.

P.S. GM-TamahaganE has voluntarily resigned on the day of the incident.

notes.title: Updated Windows 8 and 10 Support
notes.content:
A few hours before release we have updated the client to support windows 8 and 10 out of the box, meaning you won't have to configure anything.

One of the noticeable changes is the Run As Admin requirement on Windows 8 and 10. There was a permission issue which was causing the client to fail. Adding this option fixes that issue.

But because we can't target which platform Operating System it should ask to Run As Admin. Now also Windows XP, Vista and 7 also asks to Run As Admin. Do not panic, this is completely safe and won't affect your system nor your gameplay.

Update Summary:

 Khan Client now works in Windows 8 and 10.
 Slow loading bug has been fixed.
 Small screen bug has been fixed.
 Steam overlay now works as expected.
 Khan Client now asks to Run As Admin.


12 more hours to go till #bakbakhan !!

notes.title: Experimental Windows 8 & 10 Support
notes.content:
We have added an experimental support for windows 8 and 10. But the player must change a few settings themselves.

The KhanClient.exe has to be set to run on Windows 7 Compatibility mode and must be "run as admin" in order to work. (see screenshot below)

Known Issues:

 Slow Loading.
 Steam Overlay doesn't work.


This will be updated as soon as we find a better way of dealing with the issue. As of now the options mentioned above it the only way to play on Win 8 and later.

https://scontent.fmnl2-1.fna.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xtl1/v/t1.0-9/936562_196735110695796_5415848326832833629_n.png?oh=d6e0c42b8e37c55b9c3e835121d23b31&oe=5787B501
